response.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_of_rating_averages
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.avg_rate_per_day AS average,
       r.avg_rate_per_day - o.mean_of_rating_averages AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.mean_of_rating_averages

assumptions.assumption: The simple mean is taken across ratings with a non-NULL per-rating average; SQL AVG ignores NULL values, and the comparison returns no rows if that mean is NULL.
